newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander has no comment on stake report.
newsitem.headline: Santander has no comment on stake report.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander declined on Friday to comment on a newspaper report it had sold one percent, or half its holding, of Telefonica de Espana for a profit of 10 billion pesetas.

"(Such moves) form a normal part of portfolio activity and we don't (report on) movements that fall below the minimum requirement," a Santander spokesman said. "It's not a strategic move because we don't have a strategic position in Telefonica."
According to financial daily Cinco Dias, Santander sold some 10 million shares in Telefonica. It had bought the shares at less than 3,000 pesetas a share, the newspaper said.
In March, Santander said it had a two percent stake in Telefonica.
"The bank isn't making any comment. It's neither confirming nor denying," the spokesman added.
AT 0945 GMT, Telefonica was trading up 40 pesetas, or 0.92 percent, at 4,370.
